protocol: Development: use the 50 feasibility sources. Hold fixed the two original encoders. Compare the strongest supplied option with the strongest AudioSet option outside the list in each encoder. If both prefer outside alternatives, expose those and withhold a specific shared source. No thresholds and no manual aliases. Count shared candidate choices before/after withholding, with and without the primary label. Primary control for loss of useful correct selections and reduction of erroneous consensus when the target is omitted. Confirm on the 99 existing controlled recordings if practically valuable; disclose the re-use of this panel after the original 40 false agreements were known. Do not infer actual source presence from this rule.
rule: Each model compares its strongest offered description to its strongest AudioSet description outside the offered list, on the same unmodified channel. If both prefer an outside phrase, return unresolved. No fitted threshold. Synonyms may cause withholding even when the proposed name is correct.
selection: After the rule was fixed, select up to one unused Freesound source per class. Prefer fold 1; within the eligible pool sort by SHA256 of reel-source-outside-transfer/ + filename. Exclude source IDs in the previous two panels and prior project media/manifests. One class had no eligible source. No known source ID overlap across the three panels. Pretraining overlap unknown.
